hypothesis: M206 and M208 show that a single protected key can leave the near-boundary window when the policy improves normal clearance. Before further PPO, refresh the protected surface around the current retained M199/M202/M204 family and require source-diverse multi-row wrong-history outcome evidence.
success_criteria: do not train PPO or run actor updates
keep M204 as the current best checkpoint under evaluation
mine a fresh current-best-family matched-current surface from M199, M202, and M204
include wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-current-response, zero-action-history, and delayed-history interventions at boundary relocation
require source diversity across physical pairs, left steps, checkpoints, targets, and normal-margin buckets
do not change actor inputs or observation profiles
do not loosen the old M206/M208 protected-key threshold retroactively
decide whether the refreshed surface can support a multi-key protected gate and objective sanity step
failure_criteria: run PPO before the refreshed protected surface passes robustness
reuse only the old single protected key as the stage6 guard
accept a surface with only one checkpoint or one physical pair
change actor observation inputs during this gate
treat M206 or M208 as accepted by changing old thresholds

commands.name: m210_current_family_outcome_gate
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.matched_history_outcome_gate --checkpoint-policy m199_5201=runs/ppo_m199_stage2_from_m197_seed5201/checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy m202_5206=runs/ppo_m202_stage4_from_m201_seed5206/checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy m204_5209=runs/ppo_m204_stage5_from_m202_seed5209/checkpoint.pt --env-config configs/m121_human_view_zero_obstacle_relvel.json --pairs-csv runs/m210_current_family_matched_current_seed10020/matched_pairs.csv --delay-steps 10 --max-continuation-steps 60 --min-margin-gap 0.02 --max-pairs-per-checkpoint-target 0 --pair-label-mode matching --device cpu --run-dir runs/m210_current_family_outcome_seed10020

decision_rule: Admit the next objective-sanity or protected-gate design only if the refreshed surface is source-diverse and retains near-boundary wrong-history outcome sensitivity without depending on one row.
